C1_GLOBAL_SCALE_R1_R6.definition: Multiply every deployed R1-R6 cell by one global scalar k.
C1_GLOBAL_SCALE_R1_R6.motivation: Tests whether the deployed shape is broadly correct but the absolute pick scale is too high. Normalized candidate shape is exactly unchanged from C0.
C1_GLOBAL_SCALE_R1_R6.optimizer: exact weighted-LAD linear program using scipy.optimize.linprog(method='highs')

C2_ROUNDWISE_RESCALE_R1_R6.definition: Multiply every deployed tier within round r by k_r; all six rounds are fitted jointly.
C2_ROUNDWISE_RESCALE_R1_R6.optimizer: exact weighted-LAD linear program using scipy.optimize.linprog(method='highs')

C3_SMOOTH_ADDITIVE_R1_R6.definition: value = A - s12*I(round>=2) - s234*max(min(round-2,2),0) - s56*max(round-4,0) - tier_step*tier_index, where tier_index is 0 early, 1 mid, 2 late.
C3_SMOOTH_ADDITIVE_R1_R6.motivation: Low-parameter continuous full-scale family with a separate initial R1-to-R2 drop, middle-round decay, tail decay, and common within-round tier spacing.
C3_SMOOTH_ADDITIVE_R1_R6.optimizer: exact weighted-LAD linear program using scipy.optimize.linprog(method='highs')

C4_SHRUNK_MONOTONE_SLOT_CURVE_R1_R6.alpha_selection: six-class LOYO H3 O2 macro MAE; among alphas within 1% relative of best choose the largest alpha
C4_SHRUNK_MONOTONE_SLOT_CURVE_R1_R6.definition: Fit C3 on training classes; compute year-balanced exact-slot H3 O2 means for slots 1-72; shrink each exact-slot mean toward its C3 prior using alpha pseudo-drafts; apply weighted non-increasing PAVA across all 72 slots with structural positivity floor 1; aggregate four exact slots into each early/mid/late production cell.
C4_SHRUNK_MONOTONE_SLOT_CURVE_R1_R6.edge_alpha_rule: if selected alpha is 6 or 1536, C4 is ineligible because shrinkage is not identified inside the preregistered grid

O1_treatment.reason: V7 explicitly tests whether O2 scale gains can coexist with preserved historical football-utility shape.
O1_treatment.role: hard eligibility gate; never an FV fit target

development_selection.final_parameter_fit: After family selection, refit the selected family exactly once on all 2018-2023 development classes and freeze exact parameters/18-cell values before any 2024 outcome is opened.
development_selection.primary_metric: equal-year equal-cell macro MAE on H3 O2 three_year_player_equivalent_fv
development_selection.winner_rule: lowest LOYO H3 O2 macro MAE among eligible families; candidates within 1% relative of best resolve by the frozen complexity order C1, C3, C2, C4

fit_weighting.cell_weight: 18 R1-R6 production cells receive equal macro weight
fit_weighting.draft_class_weight: each 2018-2023 development class contributes equal total weight
fit_weighting.league_weight: within class and cell, frozen eligible leagues receive equal total weight
fit_weighting.occurrence_weight: retained occurrences divide their league-cell weight equally
fit_weighting.player_independence: repeated selections of the same rookie are not independent; inferential resampling clusters by stable player identity within draft class

historical_outcome_contract.availability_gate: Every development class must have nonempty H1-H3 season data before fitting. A missing required season excludes the class before fit and forces the six-class feasibility gate to be re-evaluated.

replacement_pool_position_lineage_harden.full_nfl_replacement_pool_position: season-appropriate nflverse roster position mapped by stable player ID; do not classify historical replacement pools from a current 2026 Sleeper position snapshot
replacement_pool_position_lineage_harden.reason: V5 audit found current-position lineage could reclassify historical IDP replacement pools.

question: Can a jointly fitted R1-R6 Draft Pick Fundamental Value curve preserve historical O1 shape while retaining the large O2 accuracy gains observed in V6 and eliminating the R4-to-R5 structural discontinuity exposed by the V6 D1 diagnostic?

reason_for_v7.interpretation: V6 development evidence motivates testing the whole R1-R6 absolute scale. It does not authorize promoting D1, changing V6, or treating any 2018-2023 result as fresh validation.

source_and_identity_contract.duplicate_player_same_league_rule: Retain first valid occurrence, exclude later duplicate occurrence, flag anomaly; do not discard an otherwise qualified league solely for the later duplicate.
source_and_identity_contract.invalid_occurrence_rule: Omit and flag invalid/nonplayer occurrences; do not requalify source membership after outcomes are seen.
source_and_identity_contract.replacement_pool_position_rule: Use season-appropriate nflverse roster position by stable player identity; never current-position snapshots.
stable_identity_priority: existing FantasyPros-to-Sleeper crosswalk with unique nflverse draft-class corroboration
nflverse stable ID using normalized name + frozen draft-era position + class
source_and_identity_contract.target_position_rule: Prefer frozen draft-era source position; current Sleeper position must not redefine historical rookie position.

development_expansion.reason: The frozen V6 clean source has only 4/11/12/8/17/12 known 72-pick leagues by year, so fitting an 18-cell R1-R6 curve from that tail alone would be underpowered.
development_expansion.seed_union_rule: Union deterministic discovery with all 378 V6 clean seed leagues before qualification; dedupe year+league_id.
development_expansion.union_rule: Probe the complete deterministic capped union for every year and every term; deduplicate by year+league_id; no early stopping when minimum counts are reached.

development_source_gate.minimum_reason: 12 leagues yields at least 48 raw occurrences per year-cell before occurrence-level exclusions while keeping the same league cohort across all 18 cells.

league_qualification.diagnostic_unknown_rule: Identity/classification unknowns are diagnostic and do not by themselves exclude a league.
league_qualification.positive_contamination_rule: Exclude the whole league if any slot 1-72 contains an explicit devy custom player or a player resolved to an NFL draft class other than the target draft year.

temporal_holdout_2024.discovery_rule: Do not conduct a new 2024 league search. Reuse only the 41 clean leagues frozen before V6 fitting.
temporal_holdout_2024.full_72_rule: Retain every frozen V6 2024 clean league whose already-captured selected draft unit contains at least 72 picks; no subsampling or post-outcome additions.
temporal_holdout_2024.minimum_reason: Eight leagues provides at least 32 raw occurrences per holdout cell; all ten currently known full-72 frozen leagues are retained, but the gate is not set equal to the observed count.

stage_gates.after_H3_pass: Run frozen external trade replay and descriptive market comparison, then separate human production review.
stage_gates.after_phase1: Run source/identity freeze only. Historical deterministic source expansion is allowed under the frozen search contract; 2024 search is forbidden. No V7 candidate fitting.
stage_gates.after_phase2: If any historical year has <12 clean full-R1-R6 leagues, or the frozen 2024 full-R1-R6 cohort has <8 leagues, or any retention/identity gate fails, stop before V7 outcome fitting.
stage_gates.after_phase3: Harvest/rebuild 2018-2023 R1-R6 development outcomes using season-appropriate position lineage. Keep 2024 outcomes sealed.
stage_gates.after_phase4: Run LOYO development selection, freeze exactly one final candidate or stop. Do not open 2024 outcomes during fitting.
stage_gates.after_phase5: If a development candidate exists, open 2024 H2 exactly once. H2 may stop V7 but cannot authorize production.
stage_gates.future_phase6: Only after full 2026 regular-season completion, score the unchanged candidate on 2024 H3 exactly once.
